for_senior_author: Risk of bias (reader 2 agrees, provisionally: moderate confidence): the list of excluded studies, a critical AMSTAR 2 item, is in an unread supplement; if it is absent the rating falls to low. The possible overlapping samples (new reporting issue 3) bear on 'appropriate meta-analytic methods'.

Interpretation gap (reader 2 agrees: substantial): reader 2 suggests adding that the Introduction frames the deficits as produced by methamphetamine exposure and as a well-established consequence of the disorder (p. 1).
